Diagnostics.description:
Measurements available at the time of the event. A field is null when it was not measured.

Devices must never fill a field with a guess. Unknown is always null.

EnrollRequest.description:
Everything a phone sends to join. The only things a resident types are the street and,
if they wish, the house number. There is no account, e-mail address or password.

device_id.description: Random UUID generated by the app at install time. Not a hardware identifier.
device_id.title: Device Id

privacy_acknowledged.description: Must be true: the resident saw the privacy summary and chose to join.
privacy_acknowledged.title: Privacy Acknowledged

EnrollRequest.title: EnrollRequest

device_token.description: Secret for this phone, shown once. Sent as the bearer token on every later request. Store it only in the platform keystore.
device_token.title: Device Token

anonymous_reference.description: Label other residents may see; contains no address.
anonymous_reference.title: Anonymous Reference

house_number.description: Optional. Null when the resident did not give one.
house_number.title: House Number

approximate_scope.description: Approximate geographic extent in words; never an address.

ObservationConfidence.description:
How the device learned about the event.

OBSERVED: seen live through an operating-system callback; the timestamp is the callback time.
RECONCILED: derived after a monitoring gap by comparing state before and after; the true time
of the change is unknown and lies somewhere inside the gap.
ObservationConfidence.title: ObservationConfidence

device_id.description: Random UUID generated by the app at install time. Not a hardware identifier.

retry_after_seconds.description: Set when events were rejected by a rate limit.

info.description:
Private, invitation-only API for the Neighborhood Watchdog apps.

This is a wireless **anomaly** detection system, not a certified jammer detector. Classifications are
operational inferences from connectivity reports and are never proof of deliberate interference.
